post.summary: Enable or disable limited Share Extension AI access
post.description: Requires current AI consent. Issues a share-only capability for at most24hours, bounded by the parent session expiry. It cannot authorize general API calls, developer operations, or existing unrelated conversations. Disabling, logout, consent withdrawal and data-epoch change stop access.

post.summary: Start a bounded private export snapshot
post.description: Expires after 15 minutes; creating a new snapshot invalidates the previous one. Any private write or source-policy change requires discarding the incomplete file and restarting. Metadata contains user/settings/model preference, never authentication material.

default.description: Explicit error; no private request content included

get.summary: Read one bounded private export page
get.description: At most 25 items and 1 MiB encoded JSON per page. A single entity over 1,000,000 bytes fails explicitly. Preserve source-redaction markers and user-authored text. Each cursor is scoped to snapshot and section; a changed/expired snapshot returns409.

get.summary: Read a bounded page of verified public-domain English source text
get.description: Owner-scoped to the selected imported range. At most100 verses and120KB item bytes, with an opaque range/version/policy-bound cursor. Missing corpus returns available:false. Source numbering is retained; empty/missing references are explicit and never remapped. No JCB alignment, editorial interpretation review or offline grant is implied.

get.description: Latest at most50 messages, chronological within a page, under1MiB after raw-length preflight. beforeMessageId loads older messages. sourcePolicyVersion lets clients reject mixed policy pages. Oversized single messages fail413 without truncation.
